content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Bank-holding payments and freight bill processing; target is an auction and asset disposition marketplace, not a payments business."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Consumer and small-seller online marketplace for crafts and resale goods; target runs B2B auctions of industrial equipment."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Freight forwarding and customs brokerage for importers; target sells used equipment on behalf of owners through auctions."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Owns and charters dry bulk ships; target runs equipment auctions and does not own or operate vessels."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Buys and resells furniture and merchandise as a distributor; target earns fees running auctions for owners' used equipment."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Trucking and intermodal freight for shippers; target sells used equipment through auctions and disposition services."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Engineering, consulting and government infrastructure services; target runs equipment auctions and marketplaces."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical and electrical contracting and building maintenance; target sells used equipment via auctions and online listings."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Advertising and marketing agency for brands; target earns auction and disposition fees on used equipment sales."},{"label":"C10","good":true,"reason":"Runs wholesale vehicle auctions and online marketplaces for owners, earning seller and buyer fees, plus floorplan financing; closely mirrors target model."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Owns and operates dry bulk vessels carrying cargo; target is an auction and remarketing intermediary without fleet ownership."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"On-site industrial inspection and repair services at plants; target sells used equipment through auctions and online platforms."}]}
